kebab_example: aliyun eduinterpreting submit-evaluation-task --type EN_TO_ZH --suggested-answer '聚会一团火,散是满天星' --text '相聚时大家是一团花火,_分开时在各自领域发光发热' --material-text As_flame_of_fire_we_gather,_as_skyful_of_stars_we_scatter. --outer-biz-id 433c1361-0f6e-48fc-ad51 --audio-url http://xx.com/abc.mp3 --callback-url https://abc.edu.org.cn/en/callback --region cn-hangzhou
name: SubmitEvaluationTask

parameters.help_en:
The evaluation type. Valid values:
EN_TO_ZH: English to Chinese.
ZH_TO_EN: Chinese to English
parameters.help_zh: 评测类型: EN_TO_ZH-英转中 ZH_TO_EN-中转英
parameters.name: type

parameters.example: 聚会一团火,散是满天星
parameters.name: suggested_answer

parameters.example: 相聚时大家是一团花火, 分开时在各自领域发光发热
parameters.help_en: The response text to be evaluated
parameters.name: text

parameters.example: As flame of fire we gather, as skyful of stars we scatter.
parameters.name: material_text

parameters.help_en: The unique business ID defined by the caller for this call. This field is returned together with the evaluation result in the callback. The caller must ensure that this ID is globally unique and can be used to locate the corresponding evaluation task. This field is also used for idempotence control
parameters.help_zh: 调用方定义的对本次调用的唯一业务id, 回调时将带上该字段数据和评测结果一并返回, 调用方需要保证该id全局唯一, 且可定位到自身的评测任务.同时该字段用于幂等控制
parameters.name: outer_biz_id

parameters.help_en: The URL of the audio file to be evaluated
parameters.name: audio_url

parameters.help_en: The callback URL for the evaluation result. Because the evaluation takes a long time, the result is sent to this URL after the evaluation is complete. The caller must prepare the callback endpoint based on the data structure of the evaluation task callback template
parameters.help_zh: 评测结果的回调地址. 由于评测时间较长, 待完成评测后会将结果通知到该接口, 调用方需按照"评测任务回调接口的模版"的数据结构准备好回调接口
parameters.name: callback_url
